data.title: Binance Futures Will Launch ADAUSD Quarterly 0925 Futures Contract With Up to 75x Leverage
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

Binance Futures will launch ADAUSD Quarterly 0925 futures contract, with trading opening at 2020/07/20 09:00 AM (UTC). Users will be able to select between 1-75x leverage.

Further information:

  • About Quarterly Futures Contracts
  • Contract Specification of Quarterly Futures Contracts
  • Leverage and Margin in Quarterly Futures Contracts
  • Binance Futures Fee Schedule

Risk warning: Futures trading is a highly risky endeavor, with the potential for both great profits and significant losses. Please be aware that in the event of extreme price movement, there is a chance that all margin balance in your futures wallet may be liquidated.

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team

2020/07/20

 

Trade on the go with Binance’s mobile crypto trading app:
